tests.command: python -m pytest -q tests/test_boston_nightshift_robots.py tests/test_publisher_robots_cache.py -k 'nightshift or transit_orphan'

local_live_fetch_limit: OS DNS resolution unavailable in this execution environment; raw public policy was obtained through ordinary proxy-aware requests. No production DNS validation was removed. Actual fixed production collection is still pending the consolidated release.
